products.name: Trina Solar Vertex S+ 585W Dual Glass Bifacial Solar Panel
products.description: The Trina Solar Vertex S+ 585W delivers up to 22.3% module efficiency utilizing high-density N-type TOPCon bifacial technology. Built with 2.0mm dual heat-strengthened glass for harsh tropical climates, maximum resistance against PID, micro-cracks, and salt mist corrosion in Bangladesh.
products.shortDescription: 585W N-Type TOPCon Dual-Glass Bifacial Module with 30-Year Performance Warranty.
products.compatibilityNotes: Compatible with standard MC4 connectors and all 1000V/1500V string & hybrid inverters.
highlights: Up to 30% additional backside energy yield

products.name: Jinko Solar Tiger Neo N-Type 550W Monocrystalline Half-Cut Panel
products.description: Jinko Tiger Neo 550W utilizes innovative SMBB half-cell configuration with N-type TOPCon wafers. Features lower temperature coefficient (-0.30%/°C), enabling superior output in hot Bangladeshi summer conditions.
products.shortDescription: 550W High-Efficiency Half-Cut Mono Panel for rooftop residential & commercial setups.
products.compatibilityNotes: Pairs seamlessly with 48V off-grid inverters (via MPPT) and on-grid three-phase inverters.
highlights: SMBB Technology with better light trapping
PID Resistance guaranteed via cell process

products.name: LONGi Solar Hi-MO 6 Explorer 570W All-Black Monocrystalline Panel
products.description: LONGi Hi-MO 6 Explorer 570W featuring HPBC back-contact cell structure. Elegant frontal appearance without grid lines, maximizing aesthetic appeal on modern residential villas and commercial headquarters.
products.shortDescription: 570W HPBC aesthetic high-yield panel with front busbar-free design.
products.compatibilityNotes: Recommended for rooftop systems with limited roof area requiring maximum wattage density.

products.name: JA Solar DeepBlue 4.0 Pro 560W Bifacial Dual-Glass Module
products.description: JA Solar DeepBlue 4.0 Pro 560W combines 16BB Bycium+ cell technology with low degradation rates. High energy yield under cloudy and diffused light environments common during monsoon seasons in Bangladesh.
products.shortDescription: 560W 16BB Bifacial N-Type Module for industrial rooftops and solar farms.
highlights: IP68 rated junction box with bypass diodes

products.name: Growatt SPH 6000TL BL-UP 6kW Single-Phase Hybrid Solar Inverter
products.description: Growatt SPH6000TL BL-UP is an intelligent 6kW hybrid inverter ideal for residential grid-tied systems with battery backup. Dual MPPT trackers allow PV strings from two roof orientations. Seamless 10ms UPS switchover guarantees uninterrupted power during Dhaka load-shedding.
products.shortDescription: 6kW Hybrid Single-Phase Inverter with Dual MPPT and EPS Load Backup.
products.compatibilityNotes: Supports 48V Lithium (LiFePO4) and Lead-Acid battery banks. Direct plug-and-play with Pylontech US3000C/US5000.

products.name: Deye SUN-8K-SG01LP1-EU 8kW Low Voltage Hybrid Inverter
products.description: Deye 8kW Single Phase Low Voltage Hybrid Inverter is engineered for heavy residential loads including dual 1.5-ton inverter air conditioners. Features colorful touch LCD, generator auto-start connectivity, and ability to parallel up to 16 units for massive power scaling.
products.shortDescription: 8kW Low Voltage 48V Hybrid Inverter with Touchscreen LCD & Generator Support.
products.compatibilityNotes: Compatible with all 48V LiFePO4 batteries with CAN/RS485 communication protocols.
highlights: Smart load output and peak-shaving functionality
Supports energy storage from diesel generators

products.name: Huawei SUN2000-10KTL-M1 10kW Three-Phase On-Grid Inverter
products.description: Huawei SUN2000-10KTL-M1 is a flagship commercial & large residential three-phase grid-tied inverter. Employs AI-powered Arc Fault Circuit Interrupter (AFCI) safety and integrated PID recovery. 98.6% maximum European efficiency ensures peak energy capture.
products.shortDescription: 10kW Three-Phase Grid-Tied Inverter with AI Arc-Fault Protection.
products.compatibilityNotes: Intended for three-phase commercial buildings or net-metering residential connections.
highlights: Natural cooling technology for whisper-quiet operation

products.name: Felicity Solar IVEM5048 5kVA 48V Off-Grid Solar Inverter with 120A MPPT
products.description: Designed for rural homes and businesses where the national power grid is unstable or unavailable. Felicity IVEM5048 handles up to 6000W of solar panel arrays with high PV input voltage up to 500VDC.
products.shortDescription: 5kVA 48V Pure Sine Wave Off-Grid Inverter with built-in 120A MPPT Solar Charger.
products.compatibilityNotes: Works with both 48V Lithium and 4x12V lead-acid deep cycle batteries in series.
highlights: Pure sine wave output with surge power 10000VA
Wide PV input voltage range: 120V - 450V DC
Configurable AC/Solar input priority via LCD

products.name: Pylontech US5000 4.8kWh 48V LiFePO4 Lithium Battery Module
products.description: Pylontech US5000 is the gold standard for residential solar energy storage. Boasting 4.8kWh nominal capacity at 48V, intelligent internal Battery Management System (BMS), and over 6,000 cycles at 95% Depth of Discharge (DoD). Rack mountable and parallelable up to 16 units without external hub.
products.shortDescription: 4.8kWh 48V Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery with 6000+ Cycles and 95% DoD.
products.compatibilityNotes: Certified plug-and-play communication with Growatt, Deye, Victron, and GoodWe inverters.
highlights: Self-designed BMS protects against over-charge & high temps

products.name: Felicity Solar LPBF48200-H 10kWh 48V 200Ah Wall-Mount LiFePO4 Battery
products.description: High-capacity 10kWh lithium storage bank housed in an elegant wall-mounted white enclosure with LED battery gauge. Engineered for long-duration backup for whole-house solar installations in Bangladesh.
products.shortDescription: 10kWh 48V 200Ah Wall-Mount LiFePO4 Energy Storage with Integrated Breaker.
products.compatibilityNotes: Seamless CAN/RS485 auto-handshake with Felicity, Growatt, and Deye hybrid inverters.
highlights: Sleek wall-hanging design saves floor footprint

products.name: Rahimafrooz Solar Tubular Deep Cycle Battery 12V 200Ah
products.description: Rahimafrooz heavy-duty solar tubular plate battery designed specifically for tropical operating temperatures and erratic charging schedules. Thick spine cast lead-antimony alloy plates deliver extended cycle life under continuous deep discharge.
products.shortDescription: 12V 200Ah Heavy Duty Solar Deep Cycle Tubular Battery with Ceramic Vent Plugs.
